description: This file contains helper methods and data structures for analyzing and processing serialization attributes in C# type declarations within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace.

classes.name: SerializationAttributesHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to analyze and determine serialization attributes on C# type declarations.

classes.name: TypeAnalysis
classes.description: A record struct encapsulating analysis results of a type declaration, including annotated and unannotated members, next available ID, and constructor count.

methods.name: ShouldGenerateSerializer
methods.description: Determines if a given type declaration should have a serializer generated based on its attributes and modifiers.

methods.name: AnalyzeTypeDeclaration
methods.description: Analyzes a type declaration syntax node to identify annotated and unannotated members, and counts constructors with specific attributes.
